sn38.6:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso paramassāsapatto hotīti.
sn38.6:1.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti ettāvatā kho āvuso paramassāsapatto hotīti.
sn38.6:1.4: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.5: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.6: katamo pana āvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.7: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāya. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn38.6:1.9: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.10: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāya
